text.name: sdt_relayPole_function
text.text: Extends the radio range of a drone trailer. Stand it upright on the ground within range of the trailer and unfold it (R). Switch it on with B (both from outside, you do not get in). The battery lasts about 5 hours and charges on a trailer with a running generator or at a charging station.

text.name: sdt_relayPoleDirectional_function
text.text: Relay pole with a panel antenna: it carries the signal of a drone trailer or case only inside a sector of about 99° in front of the panel (yellow stripe), but 1.75× farther than a standard pole. It covers nothing behind or beside it. Stand it upright within range of the trailer facing the field, unfold it (R) and switch it on (B). The battery lasts about 5 hours and charges on a trailer with a running generator or at a charging station.
